composition_label: Adaptive onboarding -> Semantic search -> Structured extraction -> Deep research

construction.implementation_origin: New isolated reference implementation authored for this build

shared_schema.input: schema_version, synthetic=true, profile, query, documents[{id,title,text}], fields[{name,aliases,type,required}], optional options
shared_schema.profile: experience: novice/intermediate/expert; focus_terms: unique strings; completed_prerequisites: search_basics/source_verification; explanation_detail: brief/detailed
shared_schema.output: schema_version, status=ok, synthetic=true, stages{adaptive,semantic,extract,deep}; errors: schema_version,status=error,error
shared_schema.validation: Shared validation helpers and validate_stage enforce boundary shapes, prerequisite state, ordering, identifiers, typed values, source spans and evidence-derived research.
shared_schema.span_convention: Zero-based, half-open Unicode character offsets into the original document text, not bytes.
shared_schema.strict_json: Duplicate object keys and nonfinite constants are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs: adaptive -> semantic: validated original query, preferences and prerequisite readiness; unmet prerequisites stop execution with a validation error
semantic -> extract: validated ordered document IDs and relevance scores select all and only retrieved documents
extract -> deep: validated schema fields, typed occurrences, original source spans, missing and invalid fields ground synthesis

behavior.adaptive: Novices require search_basics and source_verification in order; other levels require source_verification. User-declared completion gates search. Preference selects explanation length and relevance refinements.
behavior.semantic: Casefolded Unicode token inverted index; query terms weight 2 and additional preference terms weight 1; inverse-document-frequency weighted coverage; descending score and document-ID tie break.
behavior.optional_injection: run_pipeline(data, embedder=callable): callable receives [expanded_query, document_title_plus_text, ...] once and returns same-count, equal-dimensional, nonzero finite numeric vectors. Hybrid uses 70% lexical and 30% nonnegative cosine. Fixture-tested; never calls a live provider.
behavior.extract: Anchored case-insensitive Label: value lines; literal aliases; repeated fields retained; whitespace trimmed with original offsets retained. Strict finite numbers, yes/no/true/false booleans, ISO calendar dates. Invalid values retained with reasons and spans; required fields with no valid value are missing.
behavior.deep: Groups exact typed values per schema field; repeated occurrences preserve provenance but document support is deduplicated. Multiple values, even within one source, produce disagreement. Missing, invalid, disputed and unsupported fields yield questions. No winner or truth probability is invented.
behavior.cli: One JSON object to stdout. Success exit 0; validation, JSON, encoding and file failures exit 2.
behavior.determinism: Stable token index, ranking tie break and group ordering; no randomness, timestamps, network, or filesystem mutation during execution.

test_outcomes.cli_stdout: One valid JSON object with status ok
coverage: CLI success, usage, file, JSON and validation errors
